question: For a partner who can use only the externally shared material, is general availability promised and when may they tell customers it launches?

claims.text: External partners can consult the shared payment-retry capability page for pilot limits. That material states payment-retry is available only to the controlled pilot, general availability is not approved, and no general release date is confirmed; therefore no general launch date is confirmed for partners to tell customers.

supports.quote: External partners can consult the shared payment-retry capability page for pilot limits.
Payment-retry is available only to the controlled pilot. General availability (GA) is not approved. No general release date is confirmed.
